effects.label: Reflect Damage
effects.description: Reflects a certain percentage of incoming damage from the recipient, back to the attacker.Reflected damage ignores the attacker's DEF.

effects.label: Taunt
effects.description: The recipient is forced to attack whoever cast the Taunt debuff on them.The recipient can move freely, but can only use their Combo Attacks.

levels.text:
Casts a [Taunt] debuff on 9 enemies in a 8.5m radius around Kalistia, lasting 5s, forcing them to continuously attack Kalistia using only their Combo Attacks until the [Taunt] debuff expires. 
Heals Kalistia, restoring 21 HP for each affected target. 
Casts a [35% Reflect Damage] buff on Kalistia, lasting 15s. The [Reflect Damage] buff will return 35% of all incoming damage back to the attacker when attacked.
Accuracy required for: Taunt

bio: Kalistia is a Judicator – a holy judge that upholds the law through trial-by-combat – but her quest for justice does not stop at the edge of the ring. She will stop at nothing to uncover the truth. No matter the cost.
